verdict.rationale: Klaviyo states it is accessible headlessly through its public APIs and MCP server. Server-side private API keys, maintained SDKs, test accounts and machine-readable rate-limit headers make unattended automation feasible. However, nothing documents a CLI or CI usage specifically, so the CI part of the story is only implied. Missing for 10: an official CLI or documented CI/pipeline integration (e.g. GitHub Actions examples), and independent or hands-on corroboration of headless automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Klaviyo is also accessible headlessly — through its public APIs and MCP server — so people and AI agents can read, write, and act on Klaviyo data from outside the Klaviyo interface.
All `/api` endpoints use private API keys with API key scopes to authenticate requests.
Install a Klaviyo maintained SDK to accelerate development– offered in Python, PHP, Ruby, and Node.
Test custom integrations and apps without the risk of impacting your production account.
